provenance.tool: tests/reference/derive_models.py (Python 3.13 standard library: fractions, decimal, random)
provenance.steps: Fixture: derive_models.fit_design with random.Random(4111): 6 month ends x 8 incentive buckets of 25 bp x 3 loan-months, incentives inside (25 j, 25 j + 12.5) bp so that buckets anchored at 0 or centred on 0 group them alike, ages around a_ramp = 12, pool factors 0.55 to 1, A varying tenfold between bucket-months. Observed bucket SMM = M11 prediction at the design parameters (c_min 0.015, c_max 0.32, k 300, x0 0.003; ramp, burnout and season fixed as in settings.json) plus residuals of up to 20 % projected onto the orthogonal complement, in the inner product weighted by sum A, of the derivatives of the predictions: the first-order conditions of the weighted least squares hold exactly at the design parameters, which are its optimum in closed form. Prepaid amounts are then rounded to 4 decimal places, the first loan of each bucket-month NONE and the others PARTIAL. Expected values: Newton's method in decimal at 50 digits (analytic gradient, Hessian by central differences of the gradient) on the rounded data from the design point, an optimiser independent of the Nelder-Mead under test; check records the shift from the design parameters, the gradient and the positive LDL pivots of the Hessian at the optimum. Objective = sum over bucket-months of sum A x (observed - predicted SMM)^2, unnormalised; total_weight = sum A converts it to the mean squared error if the toolkit reports that. Parameters and objective rounded to 20 significant digits; tolerances are decision V5.
